brief.subject: EUDR: November system training dates out, readiness gaps probed
brief.headline: Commission Posts November EUDR Information System Training as Readiness Gaps Surface
brief.dek: Brussels schedules November system training while a new investigation looks at how soy, cocoa and palm oil supply chains are coping.
brief.lede: The European Commission has released November training dates for the EUDR Information System, a practical step for anyone preparing due-diligence filings as enforcement nears.

sections.heading: November Information System training scheduled
bullets: The Commission published November training dates for the EUDR Information System on 2026-10-22.
Compliance teams should check the official schedule now to get staff familiar with the platform before enforcement.
The Commissioner also attended an EUDR event on 2026-10-27, though no details of announcements were released.

sections.heading: Who is actually ready to comply?
bullets: Mongabay launched a special issue tracking how industries are adapting to EUDR traceability demands and where they fall short.
Coverage spans soy traders in Brazil, cocoa firms in Ghana and palm oil smallholders in Southeast Asia.
The series lands as the regulation edges toward enforcement following multiple delays, making peer benchmarks timely for exporters.

sections.heading: Chocolate makers hedge on cocoa supply
bullets: Manufacturers are turning to cocoa alternatives, AI and new ingredients to manage volatility and supply strain.
For cocoa exporters and cooperatives, shifting buyer strategies could reshape demand alongside EUDR traceability pressure.

brief.seo_description: EUDR brief: Commission sets November Information System training; Mongabay examines soy, cocoa and palm oil compliance readiness and gaps.
